tasks.subject: Task 1: Decimator (48k→16k anti-alias FIR)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Stateful 3:1 polyphase anti-alias decimator: 480 samples @48k → 160 @16k, windowed-sinc LPF keeping aliased noise out of the speech band.

**Files:**
- Create: app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/Decimator.kt
- Test: app/src/test/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/DecimatorTest.kt

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- decimate(480)->160 floats in [-1,1]
- >8kHz attenuated >=40dB; 1kHz within 1dB
- continuous across calls; reset() zeros history
- deterministic after reset

**Verify:** ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest --tests "*DecimatorTest*"

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/Decimator.kt", "app/src/test/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/DecimatorTest.kt"], "verifyCommand": "./gradlew testDebugUnitTest --tests \"*DecimatorTest*\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["decimate(480)->160 floats [-1,1]", ">8kHz >=40dB down, 1kHz within 1dB", "continuous; reset zeros history", "deterministic after reset"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: ORT deps + Silero model asset + session wrapper
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add ONNX Runtime (Android + desktop JVM for tests), bundle the 1.3MB 16k Silero model asset, wrap the session (576-wide input + state -> prob + new state) with input-name validation and a wrong-width guard test proving [1,512] collapses.

**Files:**
- Modify: gradle/libs.versions.toml, app/build.gradle.kts
- Create asset: app/src/main/assets/silero_vad_16k_op15.onnx
- Create: app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/SileroOnnxSession.kt
- Test: app/src/test/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/SileroOnnxSessionTest.kt

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- ORT android+jvm 1.27.0 via catalog
- model asset ~1.3MB present
- run(576) -> prob[0,1] + [2,1,128] state
- 576 zeros -> prob<0.15
- wrong-width 512 collapses vs 576
- deterministic

**Verify:** ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest --tests "*SileroOnnxSessionTest*"

tasks.subject: Task 3: SileroVadDetector + VadDetector.reset() seam
tasks.description:
**Goal:** VadDetector composing decimator + ORT session: buffer decimated 16k samples, one inference per 512-window (carry state + 64 context), hold last prob between inferences, re-zero on reset().

**Files:**
- Modify: app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/VadDetector.kt (add reset() default)
- Create: app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/SileroVadDetector.kt
- Test: app/src/test/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/SileroVadDetectorTest.kt

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- VadDetector gains reset() default no-op; Energy/RNNoise unchanged
- level(480) returns held Float[0,1] every call
- exactly 5 inferences per 16 calls (512x5=160x16)
- speech raises held prob; silence low
- reset() restores fresh-detector baseline

**Verify:** ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest --tests "*SileroVadDetectorTest*"

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/VadDetector.kt", "app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/SileroVadDetector.kt", "app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/SileroOnnxSession.kt", "app/src/test/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/SileroVadDetectorTest.kt"], "verifyCommand": "./gradlew testDebugUnitTest --tests \"*SileroVadDetectorTest*\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["reset() default no-op", "level returns held prob every call", "5 inferences per 16 calls", "speech raises prob", "reset restores baseline"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Configurable lookahead delay (onset, K=0 no-op)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Engine-agnostic K-capture delay ring + gate lookahead; K>0 transmits buffered pre-onset captures; K=0 is a provable identity.

**Files:**
- Create: app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/LookaheadDelay.kt
- Modify: app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/AudioVoiceEngine.kt
- Test: LookaheadDelayTest.kt, AudioVoiceEngineLookaheadTest.kt

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- LookaheadDelay(0) identity passthrough
- k=2 buffers (null while priming), emits 2-old capture; any open in window -> emitted old captures send=true
- flush() drains oldest-first, clears ring
- frame numbering contiguous (K-shift)
- engine K=0 golden byte-identical; K=2 emits previously-dropped onset

**Verify:** ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest --tests "*LookaheadDelay*" --tests "*AudioVoiceEngine*"

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/LookaheadDelay.kt", "app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/AudioVoiceEngine.kt", "app/src/test/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/LookaheadDelayTest.kt", "app/src/test/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/AudioVoiceEngineLookaheadTest.kt"], "verifyCommand": "./gradlew testDebugUnitTest --tests \"*LookaheadDelay*\" --tests \"*AudioVoiceEngine*\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["k=0 identity", "k=2 buffers+recovers onset", "flush oldest-first", "engine K=0 golden byte-identical", "engine K=2 onset recovered"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: MumbleManager engine-select + live-switch + RNNoise default off
tasks.description:

tasks.subject: Task 9: Eval-harness three-way VAD comparison

**Acceptance Criteria:**
